_comment_regions: Atlas is in ap-south-1 (Mumbai) and the rate-limit counters are in Upstash alongside it. The default iad1 (Washington DC) put every database round trip across an ocean -- measured at roughly 200ms each -- and would have done the same to the limiter call that now runs on every request. Co-located, not guessed: the users are in India too.

config._comment: swagger-ui serves its bundle from disk via express.static. Vercel traces JS imports only, so these assets must be requested explicitly or /api/docs loads with no scripts.
config._comment_duration: POST /api/ai/import sends a whole resume to the provider and waits for a whole resume back, which does not fit in the 10s default. The provider call has its own 45s timeout, so this is the outer bound, not the expected duration.
